These five original Inventor documents are byte-identical corpus copies of
tests/fixtures/native_geometry/inventor/conveyor. The generator validates their
fixed SHA-256 hashes and byte lengths before copying them. No document bytes,
stored previews, internal Windows paths or assembly placements are changed.

Source project: roshbeng/opcua_fusion_test_servers_and_hardware

Original directory: CAD models/conveyor_model/conveyor_model_v1
Source URL: https://github.com/roshbeng/opcua_fusion_test_servers_and_hardware/tree/d9ab21ced0a26e09a213a218249ac1938340bae6/CAD%20models/conveyor_model/conveyor_model_v1

provenance.json retains the full source URLs, original paths, Git blobs, byte
lengths and SHA-256 hashes for these five documents. Only its local file paths
are adjusted to identify this flat corpus copy. The primary qualification
directory also retains the original author's independent STEP export and
OpenCascade measurements. tests/inventor_geometry.rs compares the decoded
assembly with those independent bounds and volume.

The native-geometry corpus cases bypass stored images. The .iam assembly
requires its four original sibling .ipt documents; each is retained here with
its unchanged original filename.
